sealed_statement.canonicalization: Every B2B0-admissible single forced-color state and equal-color nonedge pair forced state admits one deterministic source-canonical pass. Source-list repartition restores axiom (v); axiom (vi) is preserved; any connectivity loss caused by source-singleton promotion to X0 is exactly repairable by constructive P7-free List-3 on separated residual components.
sealed_statement.terminal_cases: If a source list becomes empty, a forced source-singleton assignment is incompatible with the fixed coloring, or a separated residual component fails its P7 List-3 instance, the forced state is certified UNSAT.
sealed_statement.hard_return: Every nonterminal forced state returns to the same audited B0/C0/C2/C3 hard architecture after recomputation: competing survivors are inherited by restriction with unchanged source 3-lists; every remaining residual component is coupled; component messages, quotient incidence and selectors are recompiled exactly.
sealed_statement.strict_measure: M(P)=|V(G) minus (S union X0)| strictly decreases by at least one for every authorized single-force successor and by at least two for every equal-color-pair successor; singleton promotion and residual-component deletion only decrease M further.
sealed_statement.immediate_fanout: There are O(n^2) admissible raw R1/R2 forced successors from one n-vertex state before source pruning.
sealed_statement.recursion_firewall: Strict depth and polynomial immediate fanout do not imply a polynomial total successor DAG/tree. No polynomial bound on all proof-distinct forced states is sealed.

source_transfer_firewall.P7_backend: ONLY constructive P7-free List-3 on induced separated residual components with one globally absent color

terminal_trichotomy.A_TERMINAL: CERTIFIED_UNSAT in the explicit direct/List-3 failure cases
terminal_trichotomy.B_HARD_RETURN_WITH_CERTIFIED_PROGRESS: PASS for every nonterminal forced state under the one-pass canonicalizer
terminal_trichotomy.C_ESCAPE_FROM_AUTHORIZED_CLASS: NO INSTANCE REQUIRED by the proved single/equal-color route
